subject: recordTable function error: metadataSpeciesTag must be of class 'character'

messages.author: daa79bbce881751a
messages.subject: recordTable function error: metadataSpeciesTag must be of class 'character'
parts:
Hello. I'm running into an error running the recordTable function.  I've tagged my photos using digiKam with a 2-layer hierarchy.  Here is my function call:

rec.db.speciesSMM <- recordTable(inDir = dirTag, IDfrom = "metadata", cameraID = "directory", camerasIndependent = TRUE, 
                              metadataSpeciesTag = "speciesSMM", metadataHierarchyDelimitor = "|", minDeltaTime = 0, 
                              timeZone = "UTC", removeDuplicateRecords = FALSE, 
                              returnFileNamesMissingTags = TRUE, writecsv = FALSE)

Results in Error: metadataSpeciesTag must be of class 'character'

I've also tried 1) setting metadataSpeciesTag = as.character("speciesSMM") and 
                      2) creating a new character object and pointing the metadataSpeciesTag to the character object 
                      Both resulting in the same error.  

Interestingly this code has worked in the past, but I recently updated to camtrapR version 1.2 and now I'm getting this error.  I looked through the function source code and didn't see any issues.  I also reverted back to prior camtrapR version, not remembering which i was previously working from, but ended up running into other errors.

Also interestingly, the function checkSpeciesIdentification which also has a metadataSpeciesTag argument works and does not produce the above error. 

Thanks in advance for any troubleshooting ideas.

Did you install the pre-release version 1.2.2 from a post in this thread here? (direct download link)

The bug should be fixed in that version (I just double-checked, the offending lines are all fixed). To install from the tar.gz file in RStudio, go to the bottom right window, "packages" tab, click "install", choose "install from package archive" and choose the downloaded file. 
Also, the error should not appear in version 1.1, if you revert to that version. 

If the error persists, can you please post the function call, error message and the output of:

sessionInfo()
